sourceState.log: 5b944af Validate v0.11 on Fedora with Node 22 and 24

metadata.sourceMethod: git archive of the exact reference commit into a temporary directory; working tree preserved

methodology.thermalControl: balanced ordering, context before and after each process; no governor changes or arbitrary cooldown sleeps
methodology.retainedSamples: all, including failed processes; no silent retries or outlier removal
methodology.architecture: unchanged existing v0.11 definitions, four workers, two warmups, six sustained samples per process, forced GC between samples
methodology.binary: existing reservation-audit task; all transports use batch=1, count capacity=16, equal exact byte capacity; two warmups, six sustained samples, forced GC between samples, no profiling sink
